breakdown.description: For curved submerged surfaces, the horizontal component equals the hydrostatic force on the vertical projection (not the horizontal projection).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly states to use the 'vertical projection area' for the horizontal force component, matching the ground truth and fixing the original error of using the 'horizontal projection.'

breakdown.description: The vertical component is obtained from the weight of the fluid volume above the surface, not from projecting the area in the same way as the horizontal component.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification says to compute the vertical component 'using the horizontal projection area of the curved surface,' which still frames it as a projection-area approach. The ground truth requires computing it as 'the weight of the imaginary column of water directly above the curved surface up to the free surface,' which is a fundamentally different concept (fluid weight/volume). The generated text fails to capture this meaning and also omits the buoyancy direction consideration.
